setup: Set the seat so your armpits reach the top of the pad
Line your elbows up with the machine's pivot
Backs of your arms flat on the pad
execution: Curl the handles toward your shoulders
Squeeze at the top for a moment
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight
Keep your upper arms on the pad
faults: Don't lift your elbows off the pad
Don't let the stack crash at the bottom
Don't lean back to finish the rep

notes: Line your elbows up with the machine's pivot (often marked with a dot) so the resistance feels smooth through the curl.
Lower under control into the bottom position; don't let the stack pull your arms straight.
Stack numbers vary between machines and brands; compare only on the same machine.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain that changes how you move
